title: PanelArtifact
description: The contract every FEoC method script writes to. One JSON file = one dashboard panel. Written by feoc_panels.write_panel(), checked by scripts/validate_panel.py at PR time, and consumed by the dashboard's generic chart_type-keyed renderer.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema the panel was written against, e.g. "1.0.0". Lets the dashboard's renderer branch on old panels if the schema changes later.

panel_id.description: Globally unique, stable slug. CI rejects a PR that reuses an existing id without also setting `supersedes`.

title.description: Human-readable panel title, shown as the card heading.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line caption under the title (e.g. units, period covered).

forcing_type.description: Which tab this panel belongs to in the Informational Overview. Drives the All / GHG / Volcanic filter.

comparison_group.description: Optional. Panels sharing a comparison_group are eligible to be shown together / toggled against each other by the dashboard (e.g. two different ERF estimates for CO2). Omit if this panel stands alone.

supersedes.description: Optional. panel_id of an older panel this one replaces. The older panel's status should be set to "deprecated" in the same PR.

chart_type.description: Selects which renderer in the dashboard draws this panel. Add new values here (and a matching renderer) rather than overloading an existing one.

analysis_level.description: Distinguishes forcing INPUT (prescribed, harmonized across models — e.g. GHG concentrations) from MODEL RESPONSE (varies by model's own physics — e.g. how a model's radiation scheme responds to prescribed aerosol). Mixing these on one uncertainty band is misleading, so the renderer and any future comparison view key off this field.

color_role.description: Semantic color hint for the renderer's shared palette — not a literal hex value. Keeps color consistent across panels made by different people.

annotations.description: Vertical markers on the x-axis (eruptions, policy events, etc).

uncertainty.description: Optional shaded band. `source` must be set whenever this is present — see analysis_level note above for why reconstruction vs. inter-model spread can't be conflated.

confidence_regime.description: Optional. Marks stretches of the x-axis with differing data provenance/confidence (e.g. satellite era vs. model-derived era).

data.description: The plotting-ready series itself. Shape depends on chart_type (e.g. line/band use x+y; bar_breakdown uses categories; zonal_height_heatmap uses a 2D grid) — validated structurally by scripts/validate_panel.py beyond what this schema enforces generically.

meta.description: Provenance block. Everything here should let someone reproduce or audit the panel without asking the author.

drs.description: Full input4MIPs Data Reference Syntax string this panel was computed from, e.g. 'input4MIPs.CMIP7.CMIP.UOEXETER.UOEXETER-CMIP-1-1-3.atmos.mon.saod.gn'. Omit only if the panel used no CMIP source data.

production_ready.description: False for any mip_era flagged by input4MIPs as test/transitional data (e.g. CMIP6Plus). The dashboard renders a visible badge when this is false — never silently.

baseline_period.description: [start_year, end_year] used as the reference/pre-industrial period, when the method needs one.

variant.description: CMIP ensemble member id, e.g. r1i1p1f1. Omit if not applicable (e.g. a prescribed-forcing panel with no ensemble).

params.description: The parameters this run was called with (formula choice, species, date range, etc). Free-form — whatever the method needs to be reproducible.

citation.description: Reference for the underlying dataset or method, e.g. 'Jörimann et al. (2026), GMD'.

author.description: Author identifier — GitHub handle or email is fine.

status.description: draft: visible only in preview builds. published: shown on the live dashboard. deprecated: superseded, hidden by default but kept for history. retracted: known wrong, hidden and flagged if linked directly.
